key_insight: The paper introduces a large-scale ophthalmology instruction dataset and training pipeline to help multimodal AI models understand eye-disease images and conversations better.
clinical_relevance: This could improve ophthalmic AI assistants for image-based triage, explanation, and conversational support in specialized eye-care settings.
method: Built OphIn-Engine to curate instruction data from open-access ophthalmology videos
Extracted image-transcript pairs, filtered clinically relevant visual cues, and synthesized QA/conversation-style instructions
Used the resulting OphIn-500K dataset to train OphIn-VL for multimodal ophthalmic understanding
evidence_signal: The dataset includes over 500,000 instruction instances, more than 151,000 unique images, and over 29,000 video clips, and the abstract reports stronger performance than general medical and domain-specific MLLMs.
watch_item: Because the data come from web-scale open-access videos, performance and safety may depend on the quality, diversity, and real-world representativeness of the curated content.
paper_title: OphIn-500K: Curating Web-Scale Visual Instructions for Scaling Ophthalmic Multimodal Large Language Models
